Description: Per-run event markers. Baselines (R01/R02): single BASE1T0/BASE2T0 marker at onset. Task runs (R03-R14): alternating rest (TASKnT0) and cue markers (TASKnT1/TASKnT2); n = 1 executed left/right fist, 2 imagined left/right fist, 3 executed both-fists/both-feet, 4 imagined both-fists/both-feet.

onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event measured from the beginning of the acquisition of the first volume in the corresponding task imaging data file

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset) in seconds

sample.Description: Onset of the event according to the sampling scheme of the recorded modality

value.Description: Marker value associated with the event

Levels.BASE1T1: sub-089 only: rest of the eyes-open baseline. The PhysioNet source (S089R01) marks T0 for the first 0.1 s and T1 from 0.1 s to the end of the run; baseline runs present no task cue.
Levels.BASE2T1: sub-089 only: rest of the eyes-closed baseline. The PhysioNet source (S089R02) marks T0 for the first 0.1 s and T1 from 0.1 s to the end of the run; baseline runs present no task cue.
Levels.TASK1T1: onset of the real motion of opening and closing the left fist when target appears on left side of screen
Levels.TASK1T2: onset of the real motion of opening and closing the right fist when target appears on right side of screen
Levels.TASK2T1: onset of the imagined motion of opening and closing the left fist when target appears on left side of screen
Levels.TASK2T2: onset of the imagined motion of opening and closing the right fist when target appears on right side of screen
Levels.TASK3T1: onset of the real motion of opening and closing both fists when target appears on the top side of screen
Levels.TASK3T2: onset of the real motion of opening and closing both feet when target appears on the bottom side of screen
Levels.TASK4T1: onset of the imagined motion of opening and closing both fists when target appears on the top side of screen
Levels.TASK4T2: onset of the imagined motion of opening and closing both feet when target appears on the bottom side of screen
